name: 1-street-solstice-bay.jpg
caption: Golden hour on Marigold Mile: the red Solara GT rolling through live traffic and pedestrians under a neon-sunset sky, downtown towers ahead, glowing storefronts, LOW TIDE objective, Lena Vale dialogue, WAVE 101.5 radio chip, full HUD and minimap.

name: 2-police-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star pursuit under AIR ONE: the police helicopter holds its searchlight cone on the NOS-boosting Solara GT at 84 MPH while cruisers with flashing lightbars close in, skid marks on wet asphalt, AIR ONE chatter, THE LONG WAY escape objective and waypoint.

name: 3-mission-docks.jpg
caption: UNDERTOW at Copperworks Docks: Remy faces Crane's armed crew at the container gate, golden waypoint beam and ring marking Marisol's rescue, delivery truck and sedan, container stacks and crane hills against the sunset, Marisol dialogue, SMG unlocked.

name: 4-beach-shootout.jpg
caption: BURN NOTICE on Glasshouse Strand: SMG firefight with Crane's crew, crossing tracers and muzzle flashes, a burning wreck with layered flames and a smoke column, the teal getaway Solara rolling in with NOS, two-star wanted level, beach palms and pastel skyline.
